descriptions.value: PostgreSQL Anonymizer contains a vulnerability related to the anon.partial() and anon.partial_email() functions. These function can reveal the while data if the data is small enough. The issue is fixed in PostgreSQL Anonymizer 3.3.0 and later versions.

assertions.title: PostgreSQL Anonymizer: anon.partial() and anon.partial_email() can reveal the whole data

title: PostgreSQL Anonymizer: anon.partial() and anon.partial_email() can reveal the whole data
